description: This file defines the IUserRepository interface in C#, which specifies methods for user data access operations such as fetching by ID, username, email, adding, updating, and retrieving all users.

classes.name: IUserRepository
classes.description: Defines contract for user data access operations including CRUD and retrieval methods.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their unique identifier asynchronously.

methods.name: GetByUsernameAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their username asynchronously.

methods.name: GetByEmailAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their email asynchronously.

methods.name: AddAsync
methods.description: Adds a new user record asynchronously.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing user record asynchronously.
